country_selection: among countries with verified current OCIS structure, find the oldest known ocis_updated_at among active items and recommend the country with the oldest date
item_selection: within the selected country, use active items only, sort by ocis_updated_at ascending and recommend up to 5 items
structure_rule: current OCIS independent-operation status takes precedence over historical Excel item granularity
merged_rule: historical descendants of a verified active title are treated as merged into that active parent and excluded from automatic ranking
unknown_rule: countries or items whose current OCIS structure is not verified are excluded from automatic ranking and shown as structure-check-needed
missing_date_rule: active items without ocis_updated_at are shown as date-unknown and excluded from automatic ranking
rules: Do not store or require OCIS body text.
Do not store current values or replacement proposals.
Do not classify UPDATE/KEEP/REVIEW in this dashboard.
Before ranking, apply data/structure.json and keep active items only.
Historical merged or retired items must not affect recommendation priority even if their dates are older.
When the user asks for actual latest-information research after a recommendation, perform that as a separate task and show sources.
